short_caption: Desk setup and white keyboard viewed from the room center.
literal_description: View toward the desk wall from the middle of the room. The lower halves of two anime posters are at the top. A light laminate desk holds a laptop, a curved monitor showing a game, a mechanical keyboard, a glowing mouse, two white gamepads, and a black speaker on a patterned desk mat. A white digital piano keyboard on a black X stand is right of the desk, in front of the window wall. A gray step platform is under the desk; black cables, adapters, and a teal power strip lie on the beige tile floor. A navy bed runs along the right edge and the white armrest of an office chair is in the lower left.
environment: Small residential bedroom, roughly 3 m by 3 m, with white painted plaster walls, beige square ceramic floor tiles with a matching tile skirting strip, an aluminum-framed casement window with a white roller shutter, and a wood-veneer interior door.
lighting: Even overhead artificial ceiling light, neutral white color temperature, low contrast, soft short shadows under furniture; no direct sunlight through the window.
atmosphere: Clear indoor air with no visible fog, smoke, dust, or haze.
ambient_sound: Quiet small-room tone with the low hum of a mini fridge compressor and a soft computer fan whir.
